source: tls.peet.ws /api/all (server-side view of lyrebird's own handshake-probe grease-live mode: pinned rustls v/0.23.46, ring provider, GREASE profile, no ALPN)
note: GREASE mode: RFC 8701 bookends (first cipher suite, first extension, first supported version). The live server rendered the first extension as 'TLS_GREASE (0x0a0a)' and the peetprint cipher and extension sequences as 'GREASE-...'; ja4/ja4_r are identical to the rustls-baseline family because JA4 strips GREASE values (FoxIO spec).
